name: BARTEC SC9EX1 Smartscanner
summary: The BARTEC SC9EX1 Smartscanner is an intrinsically safe (Ex ia) smartphone with a built-in Zebra scan engine from BARTEC, certified for Zone 0/1/21 under ATEX and IECEx, and for Class I Division 1 in North America. It runs Android 15, with 5G and a user-replaceable battery.

otherSchemes: KCs (Korea): 26-KA4BO-0420X (gas, Ex ia op is IIC T4 Ga) and 26-KA4BO-0421X (dust)

atex.marking: II 1G Ex ia op is IIC T4 Ga / II 2D Ex ia op is IIIC T135°C Db IP64

iecex.marking: Ex ia op is IIC T4 Ga / Ex ia op is IIIC T135°C Db IP64

certification.northAmerica: NEC/CEC 500/505 (E226123): Class I Div 1 Groups A-D; Class II Div 1 Groups E-G; Class III; T4; Zone 0 AEx ia op is IIC T4 Ga; Zone 21 AEx ia op is IIIC T135°C Db
certification.protection: Intrinsic safety (Ex ia) with inherently safe optical radiation (op is)

safety.conditions: Specific conditions of use (UL 24 ATEX 3153X / IECEx UL 24.0004X): protect against impacts with high impact energy (QSG: max 2 J on transparent parts, 4 J on non-transparent plastic parts) and against processes that generate a strong electrostatic charge. Use only battery type 17-S1Z0-0020; change and charge the battery only outside hazardous areas; USB-C and DC-in ports are for non-hazardous locations only. Do not open or dry-wipe the device in the hazardous area. SE55 scan engine is a Class 2 laser (520 nm). Charging temperature 0 to +45 °C; original BARTEC accessories only.

unconfirmed.safety.conditions: BARTEC's datasheet gives a charging range of 0 to +45 °C; its product page says 0 to +40 °C.

strengths: Certified for Zone 0, the highest-risk gas zone
ATEX and IECEx certified, with published certificate numbers
Also certified for Class I Division 1 in North America
limitations: T4 temperature class: fine for most gases, but not those that ignite below 135 °C
